name: Acolyte
description: Raised around temples, rites, doctrine, and people who argue about candles professionally.

name: Artisan
description: A trained maker or trade worker who understands quality, guilds, and bargaining.

name: Charlatan
description: A smooth operator familiar with scams, false faces, and exits near kitchens.

name: Criminal
description: A survivor of illegal work, underworld contacts, and very selective honesty.

name: Entertainer
description: A performer who knows crowds, timing, applause, and how to recover from thrown fruit.

name: Farmer
description: A practical worker shaped by animals, weather, tools, and stubborn mornings.

name: Guard
description: A watchful defender trained to notice trouble and stand between it and everyone else.

name: Guide
description: A pathfinder who knows trails, camps, weather, and why shortcuts are lying.

name: Hermit
description: A secluded seeker shaped by solitude, remedies, omens, and quiet observation.

name: Merchant
description: A trader who understands routes, prices, supply, demand, and smiling while negotiating.

name: Noble
description: A person of title or courtly upbringing, trained in etiquette and influence.

name: Sage
description: A scholar trained in research, old records, and knowing exactly which shelf betrayed you.

name: Sailor
description: A shipwise traveler used to ropes, weather, teamwork, and angry water.

name: Scribe
description: A professional record keeper skilled in documents, details, and quiet influence.

name: Soldier
description: A trained combatant shaped by drills, orders, hardship, and battlefield instincts.

name: Wayfarer
description: A streetwise wanderer familiar with alleys, hard bargains, and vanishing quickly.
